model: OpenAI built-in image model (model identifier not exposed)
style: Soft classic watercolour storybook on cream paper; gentle washes, restrained vintage palette, calm composition, visible watercolour texture and soft edges; no text.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: A huge pale blue-white two-tailed comet above a small ochre observing tent; exact girl and younger boy seated separately cross-legged with countable anatomy; tiny 4 kg Papillon standing side-on with four visible legs; brass telescope safely aside; exact soft classic watercolour; thumbnail-distinct from Books 1-2; calm lower strip; no text.
images.rejected: Attempt 1: Vanilla's legs were hidden in the girl's lap. Attempt 2: Vanilla's seated hind-leg structure was not fully countable. Both were rejected because any anatomy caveat is a rejection.

images.name: dirty-snowball
images.prompt: One irregular dark comet nucleus with embedded water-ice patches, rock chips and dust in deep space, no coma or tail, object-only scientific watercolour, calm lower strip, no text.

images.name: long-path
images.prompt: One warm Sun at the focus of one long narrow oval path; exactly one inactive dark comet nucleus without coma or tail at the far end; tiny Earth for scale; no extra loops, arrows or text.
images.rejected: Attempt 1: extra inner loops made the orbit ambiguous and the faraway nucleus incorrectly carried a bright tail.

images.name: coma-grows
images.prompt: Rugged icy nucleus near the Sun releasing pale gas and dust into one large fuzzy coma, before long tails form; scientific watercolour; no labels or text.

images.name: two-tails
images.prompt: Sun at far left, comet head to its right, broad curved cream dust tail and narrow straight blue gas tail both extending away from the Sun; no arrows, labels or text.

images.name: far-and-faint
images.prompt: Brass telescope alone on the grassy hill at night; circular eyepiece inset reveals a tiny faint comet smudge otherwise lost among the stars; no people, animals, labels or text.
images.rejected: Attempt 1: the rear-view cast left hands and Vanilla's legs hidden, preventing a caveat-free anatomy verdict.

images.name: halley-returns
images.prompt: Halley's Comet over one grassy hill flowing through spring, autumn and winter bands to suggest passing years; brass telescope alone; two tails away from the horizon Sun glow; no clocks, numerals or text.

images.name: comet-dust
images.prompt: Earth crossing a curved ribbon of tiny comet dust grains; grains entering the thin atmosphere become short meteor streaks; small distant comet continues away; no impacts, arrows or text.

images.name: goodnight-comet
images.prompt: Exact children seated separately cross-legged on a ground blanket with complete countable anatomy; tiny Vanilla standing side-on with four visible legs; folded telescope aside; departing two-tailed comet; no pointing, held objects or text.
images.rejected: Attempt 1: sleeping bags hid both children's legs and curled Vanilla's hind legs, preventing a caveat-free anatomy verdict.
